# Goals

## Current selection

[T-001](../.ai-workspace/tickets/active/T-001-skills-dogfood.md) constructs the
independent STDO Skills Product with shared requirements and separately tuned
Codex/Claude tenants. Its static governing methodology is the published immutable
STDO 3.0.1 RC1 release; the Product Definition's manifest pin is unchanged.

The common WHAT was selected for bounded construction. Both tenant packages and
the native a_c 3.0.1 support increment are implemented. Actual host trials and
independent readbacks provide finite evidence for discovery, small work, source
binding, failure handling, recovery and selected release/installation paths.
The [delivery report](../.ai-workspace/work/T001/DELIVERY.md) and its exact case
index distinguish completed evidence, historical failures and remaining claims.

## Remaining mandatory qualification

Claude Q05 remains open: a bounded handoff and source-first candidate review must
be witnessed through its declared CLI/Bash/Read path. The attempted operator MCP
path is outside the frozen tenant's transport support. Its corrected preflight
and dispatch reached a nested Worker that failed login before tools or candidate
work. This is supplemental integration evidence, not qualification of the CLI
path or proof of a general skill defect. No further authentication workaround or
mixed-host substitution is selected.

Codex's finite Q05 handoff and the repaired Claude lifecycle have independent
readback. Preserve operator-assisted setup, original LC-01, timeouts and the
other stated limits. A later selected supported CLI handoff after usable child authentication, or a
separately designed and selected composition, must supply the missing handoff and
independent-assessment evidence before the delivery decision; do not reopen criteria or rerun unaffected cases for a uniform
aggregate total. The available outcome is implemented initial dogfood packages
with bounded evidence; full qualification and accepted delivery remain open.

The [T-001 ledger](../.ai-workspace/tickets/active/T-001-skills-dogfood.md#execution-plan-and-ledger)
owns work disposition. Statistical reliability, comparative efficiency, owner
acceptance, Product release and global deployment are not claimed by this finite
construction exercise. Incomplete methodology representation and fresh-machine
manager onboarding remain separate work outside this Product's delivery.
